COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Commercial Lease Agreement is entered into on June 15, 2026, between Northgate Holdings Inc. ("Lessor") and Copper Kettle Bakery LLC ("Lessee"). All parties named here are fictional.

1. Leased Premises. Lessor leases to Lessee approximately 1,600 square feet of retail space at 92 Market Street, Suite 104, Riverton (the "Premises"), for use as a bakery and cafe and for no other purpose without Lessor's written consent.

2. Term. The lease term is five years, beginning July 1, 2026. Lessee has one option to renew for an additional five years by giving Lessor written notice at least six months before the term expires.

3. Base Rent. Lessee shall pay base rent of $4,200 per month, payable in advance on the first day of each month. Base rent increases by three percent on each anniversary of the commencement date.

4. Additional Rent. In addition to base rent, Lessee shall pay its pro rata share of property taxes, building insurance, and common area maintenance charges, estimated at $650 per month and reconciled annually.

5. Security Deposit. Lessee shall deposit $8,400 with Lessor as a security deposit, to be held as security for Lessee's performance under this lease and returned within forty-five days after the lease ends, less any amounts applied to unpaid rent or damage.

6. Improvements. Lessee may make interior improvements to the Premises with Lessor's prior written approval. All fixtures attached to the Premises become the property of Lessor when the lease ends.

7. Maintenance. Lessee is responsible for the interior of the Premises, including its kitchen equipment and HVAC unit. Lessor maintains the roof, structure, parking lot, and common areas.

8. Insurance. Lessee shall carry commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and name Lessor as an additional insured.

9. Assignment. Lessee may not assign this lease or sublet any part of the Premises without Lessor's written consent, which Lessor shall not unreasonably withhold.

10. Default. If Lessee fails to pay rent within ten days after it is due, Lessor may terminate this lease, re-enter the Premises, and recover all unpaid rent and costs.

Lessor: Northgate Holdings Inc.
Lessee: Copper Kettle Bakery LLC
